description: Sample WhatsApp webhook payload from Meta Cloud API showing a conversation about spending analysis

text.body: How much did I spend on food this month?

conversation_examples.user_message: How much did I spend on food this month?
conversation_examples.bot_response: Based on your transaction history, you spent ₹3,200 on food this month. That's 64% of your ₹5,000 food budget, so you're doing well! You have ₹1,800 remaining for the rest of the month.
Yesterday you earned ₹1,200 from Swiggy (15 orders) and ₹850 from Zomato (10 orders), totaling ₹2,050. Great work! That's above your daily average of ₹1,800.

conversation_examples.user_message: Am I on track with my emergency fund goal?
conversation_examples.bot_response: Your emergency fund currently has ₹12,000 out of your ₹30,000 target (40% complete). At your current monthly contribution of ₹3,000, you'll reach your goal by May 2025, which is ahead of your June 2025 deadline. Keep it up! 🎯

Based on this month's data:

🥇 Swiggy: ₹100/order average (180 orders, ₹18,000 total)
🥈 Zomato: ₹87.50/order average (120 orders, ₹10,500 total)
🥉 Dunzo: ₹60/order average (50 orders, ₹3,000 total)

Swiggy is your best earner! Focus on peak hours (12-2pm, 7-10pm) for maximum earnings.

conversation_examples.user_message: How much did I spend on fuel?
conversation_examples.bot_response: You spent ₹2,500 on fuel this month. That's 62.5% of your ₹4,000 fuel budget. You've covered approximately 180 km for deliveries. Consider optimizing routes to reduce fuel consumption.

📊 Weekly Summary (Jan 13-19):

💰 Earned: ₹8,000
💸 Spent: ₹3,500
📈 Net: +₹4,500

Top spending:
• Food: ₹1,200
• Fuel: ₹800
• Transport: ₹600

You spent 9.4% more than last week. Your earnings are strong! 💪

conversation_examples.user_message: When is my bike EMI due?
conversation_examples.bot_response: Your bike EMI of ₹3,500 is due on the 5th of every month. Your next payment is on Feb 5, 2025. You have ₹12,000 in your account, so you're covered. Your bike insurance expires on Jun 14, 2025.

conversation_examples.user_message: Give me tips to save money
conversation_examples.bot_response:
Here are personalized tips for you:

1. 🍳 Cook at home more - You're spending ₹3,200/month on food orders
2. ⛽ Optimize delivery routes - Could save ₹500/month on fuel
3. 🕐 Work peak hours - Earn 20% more during 12-2pm & 7-10pm
4. 💰 Build emergency fund - You're at 40%, aim for 3-6 months expenses
5. 📱 Track daily expenses - Small purchases add up!

Small changes = Big savings! 💪

Your current balance is ₹12,000. Based on your average monthly expenses of ₹22,000, this covers about 16 days. Your emergency fund runway is 1.4 months. Consider building it up to 3-6 months for better financial security.

conversation_examples.user_message: How many orders did I complete today?
conversation_examples.bot_response:
Today you completed:
• Swiggy: 15 orders (₹1,200 earned)
• Zomato: 10 orders (₹850 earned)
• Total: 25 orders, ₹2,050 earned

You covered 45 km and received ₹150 in tips. Excellent day! 🎉
